component.name: WeatherDesk
component.summary: Self-hosted dashboard for a WeatherFlow Tempest station

description.p: A dashboard for your own Tempest weather station. It reads the station over your local network as well as the cloud, keeps its own observation archive so the history outlives what WeatherFlow serves, and serves the same dashboard to every other screen in the house.

ul.li: Live readings from the hub's own LAN broadcasts, with no internet needed
Radar, forecast model comparison, severe weather outlooks and alerts
An observation archive with records, normals and year-over-year comparisons
Alert rules, phone push, MQTT and Home Assistant

description.p: The embedded radar now loads from hookecho.pages.dev.

The data release: a SQLite archive with history backfilled from WeatherFlow, live streaming to every screen, severe/winter/tropical outlook cards, quiet hours, CWOP reporting and a headless container.
